one_line: Whether the CT resolves a single lamina under a certified surface.
asks: Are there two air/papyrus interfaces, one sheet's thickness apart, on this surface, in this volume?

sampling.note: One column per sampled mesh cell, along the surface normal and centred on it. 80 samples at 4 um spans 320 um, which is wider than the fused population it has to discriminate: the window has to contain both interfaces of a 120-170 um pair, and a shorter one reports the clearest slab as a column nobody could measure.

thickness_um.note: A papyrus sheet is about 35 um. The band is deliberately wide on both sides of that: what the measurement separates is a sheet from a slab, and the two populations measured were 35-45 um and 120-170 um with nothing between them.

verdicts.LAMINA_SINGLE_SHEET: the interface pair is one sheet apart: rendering here is worth its cost
verdicts.LAMINA_FUSED: the pair spans neighbouring laminae -- measured, or wider than the window read -- and a render there produces a slab that is not a sheet
verdicts.LAMINA_TOO_THIN: thinner than a sheet, so the pair is unlikely to be two interfaces
verdicts.LAMINA_UNRESOLVED: no valley between the modes: one material, or noise
verdicts.LAMINA_INSUFFICIENT_COLUMNS: too few columns carried an interface pair to say anything
verdicts.LAMINA_UNMEASURED: the gate did not run -- not a verdict, an absence of one

calibration.origin: First Letters campaign, 2026-08-28, reported to Helena as an artifact
calibration.sheet_reference_note: median over 1,x00 crops of a 3D label set, another scroll and another pipeline; it agrees with the two wraps read as one sheet and is not independent of them.
calibration.reference_implementation: halfmax_profile and column_material_depth in recto/core/frame.py of vesivius-research@1380cd6
calibration.reimplementation_note: The arithmetic is reimplemented from the reported definitions rather than vendored, because that repository is not on this host. The bands are theirs; the numbers this gate produces have not been compared against theirs on the same input, and until they are, a verdict here is this platform's own.

interface_localisation.measured: 2.399 um native against the same columns averaged x4 to 9.6 um on PHerc0139
interface_localisation.consequence: excellent median, poor tail: any per-column use needs a per-column gate, and this gate is per surface with the clean fraction reported beside the median

non_claims: this is a geometric gate, not a claim about content: a wrap that passes may hold no ink at all, and one did
it filters where one can look, never where there is something to see
the median is excellent and the tail is not: 10-15% of columns fail to localise the interface entirely, which is why the verdict is per surface and the clean fraction is reported beside it
passing is not a claim that the segmentation followed the correct lamina; that remains the geometry axis's own non-claim

the detector's own valid fraction does not discriminate: it reads 95% even with the depth shuffled inside each column, so it is not evidence that a column was localised. Thickness is the statistic that informs, which is why the verdict is read off the median and the clean fraction only bounds it
